# Valve OpenVR header

`openvr.h` and `LICENSE` are copied unmodified from ValveSoftware/openvr
tag `v2.15.6`, BSD-3-Clause.

- Source: https://github.com/ValveSoftware/openvr/tree/v2.15.6
- Header SHA-256: `1e6ed57199896cc1f7c5484e50fa18955e97be15be690beb28d998c877ead7fd`
- License SHA-256: `f56ff606104d4ef18e617921a75c73ad73b5a1a1d70c69590c29de16919e04ad`

The test renderer loads the installed SteamVR client library at runtime. SteamVR
itself is not redistributed. Geometry/self-tests do not require SteamVR.
